docs.title: Welcome to Wheelos Community
docs.text:
Wheelos Community is an open-source autonomous driving community built upon Apollo, incorporating our own unique insights and advancements. We are dedicated to fostering collaboration and innovation in the field of autonomous driving.

Our primary offerings are categorized into three main areas:

docs.title: Hardware Products
docs.text:
• Sensor Kits: (Insert Image Here - e.g., images/sensor_kit.jpg) Our sensor kits provide high-quality data acquisition for autonomous driving development.
  • Autonomous Driving Vehicle: (Insert Image Here - e.g., images/autonomous_vehicle.jpg) We offer a platform for testing and deploying autonomous driving algorithms.
  • Autonomous Inspection Products: (Insert Image Here - e.g., images/inspection_product.jpg) Specialized solutions for automated inspection tasks.

docs.title: Software Services
docs.text:
We provide a full-stack autonomous driving solution based on localization, perception, planning, and control, including:

  • Localization: Precise positioning and mapping solutions.
  • Perception: Object detection, tracking, and scene understanding.
  • Planning: Path planning, trajectory generation, and behavior decision-making.
  • Control: Vehicle control and actuation.

docs.title: Cloud Services
docs.text:
Our cloud services offer remote monitoring and remote driving capabilities, enabling:

  • Real-time Monitoring: Monitor vehicle status and performance remotely.
  • Remote Driving: Control vehicles remotely in specific scenarios.

Join us in shaping the future of autonomous driving!

docs.title: About Wheelos
docs.text: Wheelos is dedicated to advancing the field of autonomous driving through open-source collaboration. We believe in the power of community-driven innovation to accelerate the development and adoption of safe and reliable autonomous driving technologies.

docs.title: Our Mission
docs.text: Our mission is to build a thriving open-source ecosystem for autonomous driving by providing high-quality software, hardware, and resources, fostering collaboration among developers, researchers, and enthusiasts worldwide.

docs.title: Our Team
docs.text: Our team is composed of dedicated individuals who contribute their expertise and passion to the project. We have two key committees:

docs.title: Technical Steering Committee (TSC)
docs.text:
The Technical Steering Committee (TSC) is responsible for defining the technical roadmap, setting architectural guidelines, and ensuring the overall technical quality of the Wheelos project.
